blocks.x: Failure modes & the guards we ship

items: Metric anarchy, the classic killer; here one certified semantic layer owns definitions — dashboards that shadow it lose endorsement and budget
Cost creep — guarded because per-team chargeback with query tags; untagged compute is quarantined at the queue level
Silent schema drift — producer contracts fail loudly at ingest; downstream models refuse to build on drifted sources, enforced by the platform rather than by discipline alone
